title: Descent: Journeys in the Dark (Second Edition)
subtitle: Heroic tactical dungeon crawling in the embattled fantasy realm of Terrinoth
tagline: Venture into the dark depths and confront the Overlord
loreSummary: You are valiant heroes banded together to safeguard the realm of Terrinoth from treacherous dungeon horrors and the cunning schemes of a malevolent Overlord.
keyFeatures: Asymmetric 1-vs-Many tactical combat with an active Overlord
Branching narrative paths driven by quest victory and defeat
Dual-encounter quest structure with evolving objectives and map layouts
Hero class customization with skill decks, gold shopping, and relic rewards

shadow_rune_standard.name: The Shadow Rune (Standard Campaign)
shadow_rune_standard.description: The complete core campaign covering the Introduction, Act I, the Interlude, Act II, and the climactic Finale (~17-20 tactical encounters/quest sessions across Terrinoth).

act_one_short.name: Act I Prologue (Short Campaign)
act_one_short.description: A condensed introductory campaign spanning the Introduction, three Act I quests, and concluding with the dramatic Interlude confrontation.

heirs_of_blood.name: Heirs of Blood (Epic Campaign)
heirs_of_blood.description: The comprehensive 32-encounter narrative arc defending the kingdom of Saradyn against Lady Eliza Farrow and the Overlord's lieutenants.

milestones.title: The Shadow of the Overlord
milestones.description: Surviving initial skirmishes and securing the realm's borders against rising darkness.

milestones.title: The Vault Revealed
milestones.description: A pivotal confrontation determining the balance of power as ancient artifacts stir.

milestones.title: The High Wyrm's Awakening
milestones.description: Braving deadly dungeons and confronting formidable lieutenants across Terrinoth.

milestones.title: The Climax of Terrinoth
milestones.description: The ultimate showdown against the Overlord to seal the fate of the realm forever.
